primary_gt.proof_conclusion: All five tests pass: persistent monsoon rainfall was routed southward through the Indus system and remained amplified by downstream storage.

threshold_rules.peak_window_persistence_test: the wettest 7-day fraction is computed, but longer wet persistence prevents a wettest-week-only diagnosis
threshold_rules.multi_product_precipitation_consensus: grid spread < 0.20 and both monthly anomalies > 50%
threshold_rules.routing_storage_sequence_flags: all five routing and storage flags are true
threshold_rules.reported_impact_normalization: reported extent, affected population, deaths, houses, and crop fractions are normalized

criteria.name: Process proof structure
criteria.description: Returns target family, five process-chain stages, five process_tests, rejected alternatives, and proof conclusion.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for a complete structure missing one row.

criteria.name: Rainfall-window reconstruction
criteria.description: Computes 36 days, 347.8 mm, 9.661 mm/day, 15 wet days, and 9-day wet spell.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for mostly correct rainfall values with one missing metric.

criteria.name: Peak-window persistence
criteria.description: Computes 219.9 mm, 2010-08-02T06:00, 0.632, and rejects wettest-week-only reasoning.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for the peak total without timestamp or fraction.

criteria.name: Multi-product consensus
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for correct consensus with one missing anomaly metric.

criteria.name: Routing and storage sequence
criteria.description: Identifies all five routing/storage flags and the all-true conjunction.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for at least three correct flags.

criteria.name: Impact normalization context
criteria.description: Normalizes extent, affected people, deaths, houses, and crop percentages correctly.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for raw counts without normalization.

criteria.name: Concise conclusion
criteria.description: Links persistent monsoon rainfall, routed movement, and storage amplification in one computed conclusion.
criteria.partial_credit: No credit for broad event history or planning advice.

provenance.notes: Values are computed or extracted from local CSX-102 package data.
